title: Quantize
description: Moves the start of notes to the nearest point of a grid (for example 1/16), fully or partly, so that loose playing becomes tight. It takes notes and gives notes back.

parameters.name: enabled
parameters.doc: Off passes the notes through untouched (bypass).

parameters.name: grid
parameters.doc: The grid the notes snap to (1/8t is an eighth-note triplet).

parameters.name: strength
parameters.doc: How far a note moves towards the grid: 100 snaps fully.

parameters.name: lengths
parameters.doc: On also rounds the length of every note to the grid.
